Adds an optional Event Scripter fix for anyone using that extension on a dark theme.

## Added

- **Optional Event Scripter fix (`jd-es-fix.jar`).** On any FlatLaf dark Look and Feel (this theme, or JDownloader's own dark theme), the Event Scripter script editor would not open: clicking **edit** or **Add** did nothing. That is a JDownloader bug rather than a theme bug (the stock dark theme triggers it too), caused by two null-pointer errors in JDownloader's own bundled code that only fire under FlatLaf and are swallowed silently. This release ships a small, fail-safe `-javaagent` that null-guards both paths, so the editor opens normally. Download `jd-es-fix.jar` from this release and point JDownloader's JVM at it, for example `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-javaagent:/path/to/jd-es-fix.jar`. Full per-OS setup is in [docs/event-scripter-fix.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jd-plain-dark/blob/main/docs/event-scripter-fix.md) and README section 5.

## Notes

- The theme itself is unchanged and still pure configuration: no patched `flatlaf.jar`, no agent required, survives JDownloader self-updates. The Event Scripter fix is an entirely optional add-on — if you do not use Event Scripter, ignore it.
- The same fix ships built in to the [JDownloader-for-Unraid container](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader) (v4.3.0); this release brings it to desktop users of the theme.
